verified_facts: coint implements the augmented Engle-Granger two-step test with null of NO cointegration, assuming I(1) inputs.
First-stage regression includes the declared constant/trend; residual unit-root inference uses cointegration-specific MacKinnon approximations.
The function assumes no missing values and no time gaps. Ordinary return correlation is not this residual stationarity test.
adfuller has null of a unit root; kpss has null of level/trend stationarity. Rejection/nonrejection need correct assumptions and sample sizing.
sources.limit: Even a stable historical spread does not establish net two-leg profit or future stationarity. The broad spot lab does not implement an executable pairs portfolio.

verified_facts: SPA compares a benchmark loss series with T-by-k alternative model losses using dependence-preserving stationary/circular/moving-block bootstraps.
Default block length sqrt(T) is only a default; the source recommends choosing an appropriate length for the data.
SPA documentation references Hansen2005 and White2000. StepM describes Romano-Wolf2005 stepwise multiple comparison.
Cross-sectional strategy dependence and serial dependence matter; counting every correlated parameter variant or trade as independent overstates evidence.
sources.limit: We read implementation documentation, not full original Hansen/White/Romano-Wolf papers. The project uses declared block sign-flip/Holm diagnostics, not this SPA implementation; no SPA claim is inherited.

verified_facts: Creator README defines bullish FVG as preceding high below following low with bullish middle candle; bearish FVG is preceding low above following high with bearish middle candle. Source uses shift(-1), so the middle-bar label is unavailable until the following third candle closes.

Swing_highs_lows defines look-back AND look-forward swing_length. The source forward shifts before rolling extrema and performs subsequent pivot pruning. Retrospective labels cannot be treated as instant causal signals.

sources.publisher: AQR author-hosted Journal of Portfolio Management Fall2017 paper
sources.title: A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing
verified_facts: Paper studies67 traditional markets:29 commodities,11 equity indices,15 bond markets,12 currency pairs; monthly data; simulated strategy Jan1880–Dec2016 with varying available universe.
Strategy equally combines1-,3-,12-month own excess-return sign signals, monthly rebalanced long/short, equal volatility market positions, combined ex-ante annualized portfolio volatility target10%.
Simulates transaction costs and hypothetical2% management/20% performance fees; notes uncertain historical transaction estimates and unaccounted futures-roll costs.
Paper reports positive mean historical returns across markets and decades but significant drawdowns up to25%, with reversals and absence of trends causing losses.
Macroeconomic analyses note recessions not known in realtime and inflation classification performed ex post; contemporary regime associations cannot silently become causal timing signals.

Average absolute pairwise correlations estimated over36months relate inversely to subsequent trend performance; the authors also explain the portfolio volatility-scaling mechanism. This is a specific traditional-markets result, not a universal crypto forecasting law.
reviewed_sections: Full extracted paper text, particularly Data/Constructing the Time-Series Momentum Strategy/Performance/Regimes/Appendices
sources.limit: No reproduction of their historic proprietary/cash/futures dataset or instantaneous crypto strategy. Research paper evidence is not the project backtest or live exchange profitability.

method_connections.costs: Every modeled fill must include declared fee/spread/slippage; historical assumptions remain explicit until actual contract/account schedules are verified.
method_connections.time_series_trend: Public empirical evidence supports a family-level hypothesis. Hourly simple-price returns/SMA/Donchian/etc are independent adapted hypotheses, not the original monthly futures system.
method_connections.mean_reversion: RSI/threshold/volatility shock rules are hypotheses; previous official RSI2 source audit supports causal definitions, not crypto profitability.
method_connections.correlation: Training-only lagged feature/return and strategy-return correlations are descriptive. No level-price spurious-correlation or automatic causal-profit conclusion.
method_connections.stationary_spread: A future pairs study needs training-only fit, correct residual stationarity/cointegration inference, synchronized two-leg executable prices and borrowing/funding; none tested here.
method_connections.multiple_testing: 208 correlated parameter variants across9 implementation families are not208 independent strategies or9 independent economic edges. Preserve trial count and failed variants; chronology and final candidate lock prevent winner substitution.
method_connections.smc: Reveal3-candle FVG after third close; confirm pivots causally and exclude future annotation fields. Numerical thresholds and execution policy derive from docs/LIQUIDITY_PROTOCOL.md, not image/creator claim.
method_connections.data_rights: Pinned archive dataset supports current non-production personal historical backtests. Future realtime/signal/execution use must bind a separately valid source rather than silently treating archive license as live permission.
